needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'backup'; amount: number } as the body of an { on: 'etb', self: true } trigger, PLUS KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS['backup'] = "when ~ enters, put {n} +1/+1 counters on target creature. if that's another creature, it also gains the non-backup abilities of ~ until end of turn" in src/cards/render.ts
needs.semantics: Backup N. The counter half is already expressible; the missing half is 'that creature also gains this permanent's other printed abilities until end of turn', which needs a grant of an ability LIST to a TARGET with a duration — gain-ability grants only to the source and only permanently (game.ts:1280). The render entry is required separately: without it the printed 'Backup N' line scores 0 as a renderer gap and no backup card can ever be verified.
